How Did the Ayatollahs Set Up Iran's Islamic Regime? | Israel Iran Conflict | Flashback with Palki Sharma
Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said that "Iran will be free, sooner than you think", a comment that hints at regime change in Tehran. The Islamic regime was set up in 1979 after the Islamic revolution led by Ayatollah Khomeini. Does the latest escalation pose a threat to it? How does Iran's regime function? Find out on Flashback with Palki Sharma.
